name: touch-s2s-gw-sc
description: #120 stretch 2 probe (owner's third budget: route over md1_1's walkmesh), generated by runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js; boots from touch-md1-1 (stretch 1's end, kept by touch-playthrough). Input: wait 30 frames; route to gateway 1 (md1_2), at most 9000 frames, driving scenes: whenever a message window is open or the game is out of field mode, up to 3000 frames of Interact through every waiting window and, on the naming screen (gameState 5 with fieldEventCmd 6, a hypothesis), start then circle in turn (each held 4 frames, one every 30); then the walkmesh is read again and the route re-planned. Stalls as attempt 3 (120 still frames; a nudge of up to 300 frames, then up to 6 sidesteps). End check: md1_2 (0x76). Metrics: out_g (outcome), scenes (scene drives), wmask (windows seen open, bit i = window i), named (route frame + 1 when the naming screen was first seen, 0 never), nleft (frames on the naming screen until field mode came back, 0 never), smode (first other gameState seen in a drive, 0 none), evt (fieldEventCmd then), remain (triangles from the end to the gateway). Route outcome codes: 1 reached, 2 stuck, 3 timeout, 4 left field mode, 5 no walkmesh, 6 no goal, 7 no path. A leg is direction code (0 up, clockwise to 7 up-left) * 10000 + frames. Only those numbers, small state values and the field ID leave.
